Eligibility of Tenderer : Eligibility/Terms and Conditions:
1) Valid TIN Certificate (Up-to-date).
2) Valid VAT Registration Certificate.
3) Valid Trade License.
4) The ternderer must have at least 10 years experience (in place of existing).
5) The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single tender of min Taka 10 Lac on Liveries in last two (02) years.
6) The tenderer/bidder should have the Bank solvency certificate.
7) List of 5 Organizations (Govt./Non-Govt.) where similar supply (Liveries) done by the company mentioning with client name,
duration of project completion, total manpower involvement (enclose work order/contract agreement)
8) Tenderer must have a Working centre/office/branch office in Chattogram City.
9) In order to proof the Tenderers Financial capability necessary to perform the contract the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover (at least 30 Lac) over the last Three (03) years.
10) The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 15 Lac.
